## Change

Describe the behavior or measurement being corrected. Link the issue and attach the **app diff** (or identify the changed app files) needed to reproduce it.

## Fairness

Explain how the change preserves SPEC.md. Disclose any framework defaults, caching, routing, dependencies, or benchmark settings that change.

## Verification

Paste build, parity, and benchmark commands and output. Link raw before/after JSON from the same machine and state full or quick mode. Include environment details and any checks not run.
